Chelsea v Manchester United (Kick-off 12.30pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Stamford Bridge. The visitors did the double over Chelsea last season thanks to 2-1 and 1-0 victories. This meeting last year saw Matheus Cunha score just before half-time to give the Red Devils all three points. The reverse fixture in September saw United win 2-1 in a game that saw Robert Sanchez sent off in just the fifth minute, before Casemiro was shown a second yellow on the stroke of half time.
